questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne til Bergen, fordi jeg har besøgt det en gang før og dynes der var dejligt.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg har haft et skønt ophold, men universitetet var absolut ikke det, der gjorde det.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Lidt roddet, men der er hjælp online og en god studievejledning.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Fik mails.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Boligmarkedet i sig selv er ikke det værste, men norske udlejningsregler gør det svært at finde noget midlertidigt privat, da mange kræver, at man kan skrive under på kontrakt for et helt år. Gå i gang i god tid og søg hos dem, som selv skal på udveksling, så det passer med det halve år.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Der er en letbane og busser, så det er nemt at komme til centrum

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det er en garanti at få bolig på Fantoft, som er et kollegie, men med den "risiko" at man skal dele værelse med en anden udveksler - var personligt ikke interesseret i det.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Systemet er lidt outdated og det var lidt svært at gennemskue om man havde gjort alt, men studevejledningen kunne hjælpe og bekræfte.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Studievejledning og instruktioner på mail.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik det jeg ønskede mig.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Ved ikke

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: Jeg tog et kursus, som både blev undervist til BA og KA med forskellige eksamenskrav.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Synes niveauet var lavere og det gik langsomt.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Nordisk masteremne b - språket som reiskap for tanken

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Synes kurset var spændende, men det blev udbudt som et såkaldt lektorfag, som betød at vi havde flere ugers pause, fordi lektorstuderende skulle have plads til praksisperiode - så vær opmærksom på at styre udenom lektorfagene, hvis du vil have mere undervisning.
